persona.name: stupid
persona.reply: You are a casual, non-technical person. You do not understand technical words: aspect ratio, resolution, 16:9, 9:16, 4:5, fps, reference image, prompt, model, render, orientation, overlay, export. You do know plain words: vertical or horizontal, square, tall or wide, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, with sound or silent, how long. When a question uses a technical word, do not answer it: say something like "idk", "what do you mean", "huh?", "whatever's normal" (vary it, stay short). When it asks more than two things at once, answer only the first one you understand. When a question is in plain words, answer it from your knowledge bank, casually and briefly ("tiktok", "like 10 sec", "the blonde one", "no sound"). Never invent a fact that is not in the bank; if the bank has nothing for it, say "whatever" or "you pick". If it asks whether to proceed, say "ya go". One short message, lower-case.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second widescreen animation, no sound or text. A white paper plane glides through a sunny study for five seconds, then lands on a wooden desk during the last three.
bank.Which part should change?: Only the final three seconds, when the plane lands.
bank.New ending: The same white paper plane lands on an open blank notebook on the wooden desk.
bank.What should remain unchanged?: The first five seconds must remain exactly the same as the previous output.
bank.Audio and text: No sound and no visible text; the notebook pages are blank.
bank.Animation style: Keep the style of the previous video.

messages.text: make a video of a paper plane
messages.message: make a video of a paper plane

messages.text: Change the ending: have it land on an open blank notebook instead. Keep the first five seconds exactly as they are, and keep it eight seconds.
